Methodological_Formulation: m_j in {m_j,k}, m_{k!=j} = m_{k,0} (1D parameter sweeps around baseline)
Scope_and_Coverage: 81 forward SSA simulations (6 parameters x 3-5 levels x 3 glaciers)
Key_Limitation_or_Finding: Evaluates only diagonal sensitivities df_i/dm_j; cannot evaluate off-diagonal parameter interactions d^2f / (dm_i dm_j)
Equifinality_Implication: Cannot detect multi-parameter trade-off ridges away from baseline point
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: Supplement with 2D interaction grid between C_bed and kappa_shape, or freeze kappa_shape

Scope_and_Coverage: Measures directional collinearity of normalized sensitivity vectors in output space
Key_Limitation_or_Finding: High similarity (r = +0.8838 for C_bed vs kappa) proves directional alignment at baseline, but not global equifinality
Singular_Value_or_Exponent: r = +0.8838 (C_bed vs kappa), r = +0.9739 (C_schoof vs h_exp)
Equifinality_Implication: Local collinearity prevents simultaneous unconstrained optimization without regularization
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: Use Tikhonov regularization with prior covariance matrix Sigma_m to penalize deviations from priors

Methodological_Formulation: J_tilde_ij = (m_j / y_i) * (dy_i / dm_j); SVD: J_tilde = U Sigma V^T
Scope_and_Coverage: Examines principal parameter sensitivity directions across gate velocity and GL discharge
Key_Limitation_or_Finding: Mode 1 has 99.8% projection on h_exp; singular value is 37.39
Equifinality_Implication: Thickness exponent dominates boundary-layer response; small errors in h_exp completely overwhelm friction signals
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: Lock h_exp = 4.75; eliminates ill-conditioning from Mode 1

Methodological_Formulation: Second principal singular vector of J_tilde
Scope_and_Coverage: Governs basal sliding resistance across all three glaciers
Key_Limitation_or_Finding: Mode 2 has 99.7% projection on C_bed; singular value is 4.20
Equifinality_Implication: C_bed is the dominant, highly well-conditioned sliding parameter
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: C_bed is authorized as primary calibrated parameter for velocity matching

Scope_and_Coverage: Evaluates parameter directions in numerical null space
Key_Limitation_or_Finding: Mode 5 is 95.4% kappa_shape (sigma_5 = 0.0242); Mode 6 is theta_buttress (sigma_6 ~ 0 in steady state)
Equifinality_Implication: System is severely ill-conditioned (rank deficient) if all 6 parameters are inverted simultaneously
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: Freeze kappa_shape, A_glen, and h_exp; reduces active parameter dimension from 6 to 3, restoring well-posedness

Methodological_Formulation: alpha = (m + n + 3) / (m + 1) for Weertman sliding tau_b = C |u|^(m-1) u and Glen law n
Scope_and_Coverage: Analytical derivation of matched asymptotic grounding-line flux (Schoof 2007 eq. 30)
Equifinality_Implication: Exponent is a mathematical constant of the rheology/sliding pair, not an empirical tuning parameter
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: Enforce h_exp = 4.75 as fixed analytical constant; never calibrate

Methodological_Formulation: q_GL = C_schoof * [ A (rho_i g)^4 (1 - rho_i/rho_w)^3 / (64 C_bed) ]^(3/4) * H_GL^4.75
Scope_and_Coverage: Boundary layer flux prefactor matching 1D theory to 2D/3D full-Stokes transition
Key_Limitation_or_Finding: C_schoof absorbs 2D stress bridges, transition flexure, and effective pressure. Decoupled if C_bed is fixed from velocity first.
Equifinality_Implication: If C_schoof and C_bed are calibrated together on discharge, they are 100% collinear (C_schoof ~ C_bed^0.75)
Stage_3B_Methodological_Resolution: Sequential calibration hierarchy: Step 1 calibrate C_bed on velocity gate; Step 2 calibrate C_schoof on regional mass continuity
